proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : IsLocalRing R := IsLocalRing.of_unique_max_ideal h
    exact fun a b ha hb => IsLocalRing.nonunits_add ha hb
  · intro h
    have : IsLocalRing R := IsLocalRing.of_nonunits_add h
    exact ⟨IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R, IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal.isMaximal R, fun m hm => IsLocalRing.eq_maximalIdeal hm⟩
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R], (∃! m : Ideal R, m.IsMaximal) ↔ ∀ a b : R, a ∈ nonunits R → b ∈ nonunits R → a + b ∈ nonunits R
